AA58

- Growing on fallen American Linden tree in low, moist draw in oak woodland.
- Smell: doughy.
- Taste: very bitter.
- Ultraviolet: greenish-yellow on lamellae, stipe and parts of the cap at 365nm.

- Spore Print: orangish-brown
